name: 3D Box: Box 0 moves north · 1t at (0, 5, 1) [case 45]
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Box 0: 3 cells, starting at (0, 4, 1) through (2, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 1: 2 cells, starting at (2, 4, 2) through (3, 4, 2); Box 2: 2 cells, starting at (3, 4, 3) through (4, 4, 3); Box 3: 2 cells, starting at (4, 4, 4) through (5, 4, 4). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Box 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north; Box 1 moves 1 north; Box 2 moves 1 north; Box 3 moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
